name: Eglon
bio: Eglon was the king of Moab. When Israel did evil in the LORD's sight, the LORD strengthened Eglon, who allied with the Ammonites and Amalekites, captured the City of Palms, and subjected Israel to his rule for eighteen years (Judges 3:12-14). When the people cried out to the LORD, he raised up the Benjamite Ehud as their deliverer. Using the pretext of delivering tribute, Ehud gained a private audience with Eglon and drove a double-edged dagger hidden on his right thigh into his belly, killing him (Judges 3:15-22). Eglon's death opened the way for Israel's liberation from eighteen years of Moabite oppression.
